eee383bc-5b08-4c44-978b-de0acb4b16c6_chu.content: All managers have a specific responsibility to operate within the boundaries of this policy to ensure that all staff understand the standards of behaviour expected of them and to take action when behaviour falls below its requirements.

eee383bc-5b08-4c44-978b-de0acb4b16c6_chu.content: supplements and similar substances that are legally and commercially available in the United Kingdom. Aims of the Policy This Policy aims to:

eee383bc-5b08-4c44-978b-de0acb4b16c6_chu.content: Health and Safety Misuse of drugs can lead to reduced levels of attendance reduced efficiency and performance along with impaired judgement and decision-making. Employees should be aware that anyone under the influence of controlled drugs is a risk to everyone around them and should be alert to possible signs of drugs abuse. Such indicators commonly include:

eee383bc-5b08-4c44-978b-de0acb4b16c6_chu.heading: Sudden changes in behaviour Confusion Irritability Fluctuations in mood and energy Impairment of per
eee383bc-5b08-4c44-978b-de0acb4b16c6_chu.content: Sudden changes in behaviour Confusion Irritability Fluctuations in mood and energy Impairment of performance and Increase in short term sickness absence.

eee383bc-5b08-4c44-978b-de0acb4b16c6_chu.content: If employees notice a colleague displaying any or all of these symptoms employees should encourage them seek assistance through their manager [insert name and Job Title] If they will not seek help themselves

eee383bc-5b08-4c44-978b-de0acb4b16c6_chu.content: employees should draw the matter to the attention of their manager. Employees should not under any circumstances discuss their concerns with any other colleagues.

eee383bc-5b08-4c44-978b-de0acb4b16c6_chu.heading: which are legal substances which have the effect of illegal drugs. No non-prescription drugs can be

eee383bc-5b08-4c44-978b-de0acb4b16c6_chu.content: but are not restricted to driving on company business when on call or standby duties or when on trips for company business training or social events.

eee383bc-5b08-4c44-978b-de0acb4b16c6_chu.content: Disciplinary Action A breach of these rules will be defined as gross misconduct and it is likely that the employee in question will face summary dismissal. If

3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.content: either by the employee or the Company. It does not form part of the employees’ terms and conditions of employment and may be varied

3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.content: withdrawn or replaced by the Company. Principles Resignation An employee who resigns must provide the Company with his or her written notice of resignation. An employee who resigns will be required to work his or her full contractual notice unless otherwise agreed.

3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.content: The last day of service for pay purposes will be quoted in all letters accepting resignation and will be the last working day on which the employee attends work or is on paid leave. If an employee does not work his or her full contractual notice period without the Company’s prior authorisation

3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.heading: the employee will not be paid for the part of the notice period that has not been worked. [The Compa
3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.content: the employee will not be paid for the part of the notice period that has not been worked. [The Company may deduct from an employee’s final salary payment costs incurred on account of the employee failing to work his or her full notice period.]

3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.heading: Dismissal An employee whose appointment is terminated for any reason will be provided with a written
3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.content: Dismissal An employee whose appointment is terminated for any reason will be provided with a written statement of the reasons for the dismissal. The last day of service for pay purposes will be quoted in all letters terminating service and will be the last working day on which the employee attends work or is on paid leave. Where the Company dismisses an employee

3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.content: If the Company dismisses an employee without notice for example in cases of gross misconduct the Company will explain the reasons for its decisions.

3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.content: Redundancy Where the Company dismisses an employee by reason of redundancy it will give the employee his or her full contractual notice and will require the employee to work his or her notice period unless otherwise agreed.

3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.content: Retirement An employee who retired must provide the Company with his or her written notice of retirement in accordance with the notice period set down in his or her contract of employment. The employee is required to work their notice unless otherwise agreed.

3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.content: with an additional week’s notice per completed year of service after two years’ continuous service up to a maximum of 12 weeks. After the employee’s request and with the agreement of the employee’s line manager

3a7b756f-df20-4b7c-8beb-bc5911051a19_chu.content: If on termination of an employee’s employment he or she has taken paid annual leave in excess of accrued entitlement he or she will be required to reimburse the Company (by means of deduction from salary if necessary) in respect of this holiday.
